name: chiken-relaxed-yukkuri-v1
intended_use: Base portrait generation for Yukkuri-style commentary assets

model_recommendation.notes: Use any SD1.5 or SDXL anime-oriented checkpoint with clean line art output.

prompts.positive: masterpiece, best quality, anime illustration, relaxed mascot character, soft rounded face, simple eyes, small mouth, low-tension expression, friendly smile, fluffy dark hair, slightly messy short hair, casual hoodie, clean lineart, soft cel shading, muted colors, readable silhouette, streamer avatar style, yukkuri commentary friendly, front-facing portrait, upper body, plain background
prompts.negative: photorealistic, realistic skin, 3d render, extra fingers, extra hands, bad anatomy, detailed wrinkles, overly dramatic lighting, horror, grotesque, text, watermark, logo, signature, cluttered background, sharp jawline, muscular body, old face, glossy latex, noisy details

variants.neutral: blank expression, relaxed eyes, tiny smile, calm mood
variants.happy: cheerful expression, closed smiling eyes, open smile, upbeat but soft mood
variants.troubled: wry smile, uneasy eyes, slightly tilted head, comedic awkwardness

adjustment_guide.more_simple: Add simple mascot design, flat colors and reduce cfg to 5.5.
adjustment_guide.more_expressive: Raise denoise to 0.55 and append one variant prompt.
